title: New! Bacon Pancakes
description: Enhanced survival with a sprinkle of tech
body:
We've hand picked the Top Favorite mods from our team and supporters to create what we hope will be the best Minecraft steampunk experience offered today! With More then plenty of tech to start a new age, forge & Automate your way in a exciting new world brought to one of the worlds favorite games.

We hope your willing to take a chance and come ride the pancake express with us! Our Team of Pancakes have hand chosen there favorite 1.20.1 mods to create one of the best Steam punk experience's we can provide. A Fine Tuned Modpack used along with mods such as ; Create (and various addon's) Apotheosis(Zenith), Farmers Delight & Various addons, Map Atlas
